versions.changelog:
Tibetan Buddhist Product Article Generator v1.1.0

- Now generates ~1000-word Simplified Chinese articles on Tibetan Buddhist products from draft Markdown, with at least 3 fact-checked sections and matching images.
- Adds automatic extraction of product themes (e.g., 唐卡/Thangka, 法器, 佛像) and integrates verified online research into the writing process.
- Creates hero and section images in Tibetan thangka style (PNG format), giving each file a timestamp-based name.
- Includes robust error handling: directory and file checks, topic recognition fallback, network or image generation failures, and usage/status output files.
- Provides automation flags (such as --dry-run) and generates run metadata (JSON) with research source logs.
- Offers detailed input/output rules, step-by-step flow, and example test cases for easy adoption.
